meta.title: Harness2 Sweeps
meta.description: Refine an agent harness against one or more tasks with Google Research's Harness2 loop, running real DeepSeek Harness sessions as the solver and the editor.

harness2_improve.title: Start a Harness2 sweep
harness2_improve.description: Refine a base harness (AGENTS.md, skills, scripts, subagents) against a stream of tasks in the background.

harness2_result.title: Check a Harness2 sweep
harness2_result.description: Report whether a sweep is running, finished with an adopted harness, failed, or was cancelled.

harness2_cancel.title: Cancel a Harness2 sweep
harness2_cancel.description: Stop a running sweep and the DSH sessions it launched.
